app.stop: Stop the dev process started for this check with Ctrl+C.

behaviour.name: Add a reading-list item
reach: Open /list with an empty local list.
Add a title; expect it to appear once.
Submit an empty title; expect validation and no new item.

behaviour.name: Parse an item import without a screen
reach: Pass one valid record, then malformed input; inspect the returned records or validation error.

tests.targeted: npm test -- <test-file> (replace <test-file> with a relevant existing test path)
